title: [DOC2-1] Relay guide's restore procedure brings back deregistered admission keys
description: Review finding DOC2-1: Relay guide's restore procedure brings back deregistered admission keys (lens DOC2). Location: guides/relay-operator.md:1614 (§8.5 step 7), :1481 (§8.1 Database row); spec/10-relays.md:644. Fix: Spec §10.4.7 says: "MUST NOT reinstate admission key registrations from the backup ... It starts with no registrations and answers `unknown-token` for every token". Guide step 7 says instead: "A restored database holds the registrations of the backup time: keys the CO deregistered since then are admitted again". Rewrite step 7 to match. After a restore, purge every registration and per-token `ts` record, answer `unknown-token`, and notify each agreement's `contact` that registrations were lost. Restored envelopes and blobs may be kept within retention and served once their token is re-registered. In §8.1, mark the registration and `ts` state as backed up for audit only and never restored. A side effect of the purge: dropping `ts` state is safe because the CO re-registers with fresh requests. Full text: notes/review2/DOC2-verified.md and notes/review2/DOC2.md.
